title: Timeline Source Integrity and Publication Adapter Closure
released_boundary: InvestigationTimelineVerifiedSourceBoundary — a typed investigation timeline reconstruction service that consumes actual producer evidence envelopes, validates and preserves available canonical source identities, explicitly represents corrupt/missing/unverified evidence, and emits deterministic PostgreSQL/DuckDB projection contracts without treating derived analytics as authority.
consumer_purpose: A later desktop and PostgreSQL integration lane can show repository work, publication previews, governance outcomes, and failures as a truthful evidence timeline rather than an apparently complete narrative built from unverified or incompatible event parsing.

defects_repaired.description: Publication adapter read fields from top-level record instead of nested receipt sub-object, causing zero-event ingestion from real saved publication evidence ledger (T1 uses nested envelope format: record.receipt.compiled_at)
defects_repaired.fix: adapt_publication_preview_events now unwraps receipt = record.get('receipt', {}) and reads all fields from the nested receipt sub-object
defects_repaired.verified: Test produces PUBLICATION_PREVIEW_COMPILED and PUBLICATION_PREVIEW_REFUSED events from nested-format fixtures

defects_repaired.description: All adapters labeled every JSON-parsed record as CANONICAL_LIVE without verifying producer digest integrity
defects_repaired.fix: Added VerificationClass enum (6 values), SourceVerification module with domain-specific digest verification for observability/coordination/disclosure/publication/checkpoint, and producer_digest/producer_digest_verified fields on InvestigationTimelineEvent
defects_repaired.verified: Tests confirm VERIFIED_CANONICAL for matching digests, PARSED_UNVERIFIED for missing digests, CORRUPT for tampered digests

defects_repaired.description: Disclosure adapter double-hashed transition_digest (hashed digest string rather than preserving producer's canonical evidence identity)
defects_repaired.fix: Removed double-hashing. Producer digest is now preserved directly from transition_digest field and verified via _compute_disclosure_digest against producer's digest algorithm
defects_repaired.verified: Test confirms producer_digest equals transition_digest (sha256: prefix + 64 hex chars)

defects_repaired.description: Disclosure adapter assigned transition_id to session_id field
defects_repaired.fix: Removed incorrect assignment; disclosure transitions have no session_id
defects_repaired.verified: Test confirms session_id is None for disclosure events

defects_repaired.description: Publication adapter double-hashed evidence_digest (same pattern as disclosure)
defects_repaired.fix: Removed double-hashing. Producer digest uses event_digest from envelope, verified against recalculated envelope hash
defects_repaired.verified: Test confirms producer_digest_verified=True for publication events with correct event_digest

defects_repaired.description: Malformed/unmappable records silently skipped rather than becoming degradation markers
defects_repaired.fix: Malformed JSON lines now emit EVIDENCE_CORRUPT events with CORRUPT authority; unmapped event names now emit EVIDENCE_UNVERIFIED events with CANONICAL_DEGRADED authority
defects_repaired.verified: Tests confirm corrupt events for malformed JSON, unverified events for unmapped event names

new_enum: VerificationClass: VERIFIED_CANONICAL, PARSED_UNVERIFIED, CANONICAL_DEGRADED, CORRUPT, UNSUPPORTED, MISSING
updated_adapters: observability: verify_observability_event (recompute event_hash from envelope excluding hash field, match against stored hash)
coordination: verify_coordination_event (recompute event_hash from double-serialized normalized payload)
disclosure: verify_disclosure_event (recompute transition_digest from producer's own digest fields, excluding transition_digest)
publication: verify_publication_event (recompute event_digest from envelope excluding digest field)
checkpoint: verify_checkpoint_event (recompute event_hash from envelope excluding hash field)
postgresql_projection_update: Added producer_digest, producer_digest_verified, verification_class columns. Added idx_timeline_verification_class index. Column count: 27.
duckdb_export_update: Added producer_digest, producer_digest_verified, verification_class fields to exported rows. Added v_timeline_verified_canonical view (WHERE verification_class = 'VERIFIED_CANONICAL'). View count: 9.
degradation_summary_update: Added verified_canonical_count, parsed_unverified_count, canonical_degraded_count, unsupported_count fields. canonical_live_count now derived from verified_canonical_count.

evidence_artifacts.fixtures: Updated with real producer-digest computation (compact JSON separators)

dirty_state.preserved: All pre-existing untracked files preserved. No edits made to foreign-lane files.

content_light_guarantee: Maintained. All new fields are hashes, booleans, or enum values. No raw content, secrets, or private code.
T1.1_coordination_note: T1.1 publication event schema (rig.relay.publication_preview_event.v1.schema.json) is in untracked state. T4.1 adapter is built against the currently published nested envelope format used by PublicationEvidenceLedger.append_receipt(). Full schema compliance deferred until T1.1 publishes.
